Frequently Asked Questions

Everything You Need To Know About Trading With Us

Got questions about gold testing, minimum quantities, or WhatsApp orders on +256 755 848 198? Here are the most common inquiries.

How does WhatsApp ordering work at T.J Concepts?
When you select your desired service or calculate a quote on our site, clicking "Send to WhatsApp" pre-formats all your specifications (weight, purity karat, preferred settlement) into a concise message directed to +256 755 848 198. Our chief bullion officer responds immediately to confirm current live pricing and arrange delivery or assaying.
What is the minimum quantity of gold I can buy or sell?
For retail customers, we buy and sell from as little as 10 grams (or 1 Troy Ounce). For refining batches, our induction smelters efficiently process batches starting at 100 grams up to industrial lots exceeding 50 kilograms.
How do you determine the purity and valuation of scrap gold?
We use laboratory-grade Thermo Scientific X-ray Fluorescence (XRF) spectrometers to determine elemental composition to 0.01% accuracy without damaging your item. For larger melted bars, we conduct certified fire assaying (cupellation). Payouts are benchmarked directly against the international spot price.
Do you provide export permits and international delivery?
Yes. T.J Concepts is fully licensed to prepare all government royalties, mineral export documentation, customs clearance, and insured armored freight to major gold hubs including Dubai (DMCC), Zurich, London, and Antwerp.
